name: Productivity Panel (abelrigm)
summary: Show each associate's rate and idle time, and refresh both together every 5 minutes.
detail: On MEM3 assignments, Primary Grading rate and idle time update on one cycle. The rate is drawn as soon as its page arrives. Idle pages start then, four at a time, line people before BIGS, one try per person. Someone who shows up before the next cycle gets that rate and an idle page without waiting. At five minutes everyone is recalculated, and new people after that are picked up the same way. Each row, the line idle total, and the floor idle total update as each person comes back. BIGS idle stays on those rows and out of the totals. A failed pull keeps the last good number. Installed copies check the repository update link and open the new version when it is higher. On the MAASK authentication page, it opens the IT login chooser and clicks IT Service Login. On the menu location page it types MEM3 and presses Enter. While the problem-solve sheet scans someone in or out, the panel stops rewriting rows so Control Tower can update the station. Leaving Early is a yellow button on the associate card, above Unassign. When that person is already leaving, the card shows the time and updates as soon as the time changes. Saving a new time or a changed time shows a green check on the time panel for 3 seconds, then the check fades. It opens a prompt for the time and AM or PM, with that person's login filled in. The time box is 00:00 and AM or PM sits on its right. Show Leaving Early, left of Unassign Early Outs, opens the list of who is leaving and when. A mistaken early out can be cleared from that list. Copy early debug on that list records each mark, clear, and unassign. Someone counts as unassigned only when their login leaves the board. A menu that closes without that is clicked again, up to four times, and the click style changes on each try. Clear removes any row on the list, including someone who already left or came back. Every computer running this script shares one leaving list, so an early out marked on one laptop shows on the others. Unassign Early Outs sits left of Time issues. The password opens in the center. After it is accepted, that panel becomes a progress bar. Stop ends the run and lists who was unassigned and who is left. It unassigns only people whose time has passed. Every mark, update, unassign, and return is recorded with who did it.

name: MEM3 Control Tower - PS Board (abelrigm)
summary: Scan a typed login in or out of a problem-solve station on Control Tower.
detail: On MEM3 assignments, a PS board button sits on the CRET Problem Solve group and stays out of the productivity panel. The sheet places each associate on the line map, with the B station stacked on the split side. Audit PS, Grey Totes, Gatekeeper, Bigs PS, Add-Ins, and Exceptions sit on one row under the lines, each the same size as a line station. Click a station and type a login, for example abelrigm. Scan in clicks the None link, types the login into the search Control Tower opens, and clicks Assign. Scan out clicks the login and then Unassign. Scan in waits until Assign stays on that person, then clicks it once. Copy debug puts the station, the row, and any open search or Assign button on the clipboard. The sheet follows the group as the page updates. Anyone whose station is not on the sheet is listed under it.
